english: Sancoins lies in the countryside of Berry on the Aubois, a tributary of the Loire. Its long history is reflected in the changing forms of its name: the place appeared as Cenconio in the twelfth century, and variants of Cenquoings were used in the seventeenth. The spelling Sancoins was established by the eighteenth century, preserving the name of a settlement known for many centuries.
simp_chinese: 桑宽位于贝里乡间的欧布瓦河畔，这条河流汇入卢瓦尔河。地名的变化反映了此地漫长的历史：12世纪它见于记载时称为森科尼奥，17世纪则使用森宽一类的拼法。到18世纪，桑宽这一拼写已经出现，延续着这处古老聚落的名字。

english: Sandakan Bay opens onto the Sulu Sea on the northeastern coast of Borneo. Sheltered islands and waterways connect the bay to the lower Kinabatangan and the forested interior. Coastal communities including the Bajau inhabited this maritime region, while forest goods such as beeswax, rattan and edible birds' nests entered networks of exchange reaching across the sea toward the Sulu archipelago and beyond.
simp_chinese: 山打根湾位于婆罗洲东北岸，向苏禄海敞开。受庇护的岛屿与水道将海湾同京那巴当岸河下游及森林覆盖的内陆联系起来。包括巴瑶人在内的沿海社群居住于这片海洋地区，蜂蜡、藤条和食用燕窝等林产进入跨海延伸至苏禄群岛及更远地区的交换网络。

english: Sandakan Harbour lies on the northeastern coast of Borneo, opening towards the Sulu Sea. It is one of a succession of sheltered bays along this deeply indented shore, south of Paitan and Labuk bays. Across the sea, the islands of the Sulu archipelago extend towards the southern Philippines.
simp_chinese: 山打根港位于婆罗洲东北岸，向苏禄海敞开。它是这片曲折海岸上一连串较隐蔽海湾之一，位于拜丹湾和拉布湾以南。隔海相望，苏禄群岛向菲律宾南部延伸。

english: Sandan lies in the wooded country of central Cambodia, northeast of the Tonle Sap. Streams from the northern hills flow through the region toward the Stung Sen, which carries water south to the great lake. Forest and river valleys give way to cultivated lowlands farther downstream. Seasonal rains swell the watercourses, linking the uplands of the Dangrek region with the fertile basin around the lake.
simp_chinese: 三丹位于柬埔寨中部林地，坐落在洞里萨湖东北方。北方山丘流下的溪水穿过当地，汇入向南流往大湖的森河。森林与河谷在下游逐渐过渡为耕作的低地。季风雨使水道涨满，将扁担山地的高地与大湖周围肥沃的盆地连接起来。

english: Sandaran lies on the eastern coast of Borneo near the great Mangkalihat peninsula. Behind the shore stretches a landscape of forest and limestone karst, where cliffs and caves punctuate the hills. Cave paintings in this part of Borneo bear witness to human presence far older than the kingdoms that later ruled the neighboring coasts. The peninsula projects into the waters between Borneo and Sulawesi.
simp_chinese: 桑达兰位于婆罗洲东岸，靠近广阔的芒卡利哈特半岛。海岸后方是森林和石灰岩喀斯特地貌，山间点缀着峭壁与洞穴。这片婆罗洲地区的洞穴壁画见证着远早于后来统治邻近海岸的王国的人类活动。半岛伸入婆罗洲与苏拉威西之间的水域。

english: Sandaré lay in the Khasso country of western Mali, where the Falémé and Senegal rivers and their valleys supported farming and gold working. The Khasso state traded gold and kola from its hills with merchants on the Senegal River and beyond, and Mandinka and Soninke communities mingled in its towns.
simp_chinese: 桑达雷位于马里西部的卡索地区，法莱梅河与塞内加尔河及其河谷支撑着农耕与采金。卡索国把山地出产的黄金和可乐果交给塞内加尔河及更远地方的商人，曼丁卡人与索宁克人则在城镇中杂居。

english: Sandawe country lies among the hills and rock shelters of central Tanzania, near Kondoa. Paintings on the shelter walls depict people and animals, preserving traces of hunter-gatherers and later farming communities over many centuries. Some shelters retain ritual importance for nearby communities. The Sandawe language and the region's artistic traditions give this landscape a distinctive place in the cultural history of East Africa.
simp_chinese: 桑达韦人的土地位于坦桑尼亚中部孔多阿附近，山丘间分布着众多岩棚。岩壁上的人和动物图像保存了狩猎采集者及后来农耕社群数百年来的活动痕迹。有些岩棚仍对附近社群具有仪式意义。桑达韦语言与当地艺术传统，使这片景观在东非文化史上独具地位。

english: Sande lies in a valley at the head of Sandebukta, an inlet of the Oslofjord. Its medieval stone church has a rectangular nave and a narrower chancel. First recorded in 1387, it suffered a severe fire in 1783 that left little but the walls standing. The church was rebuilt over the following eight years, preserving its medieval soapstone font, and served as an election church in 1814.
simp_chinese: 桑讷位于奥斯陆峡湾支湾桑讷湾尽头的山谷中。当地中世纪石教堂有长方形中殿和较窄的唱诗班席，最早见于1387年的记载。1783年大火几乎只留下墙壁，教堂在随后八年间重建，保留了中世纪皂石洗礼池，并于1814年用作选举教堂。

english: Sandıklı lies in a basin of western Anatolia, among the roads linking the interior with the Aegean country. Its Great Mosque was commissioned in 1379 by Bahaeddin Ömer, son of Alaeddin, during the rule of the Germiyanids. The town is also known for the Hüdai hot springs, whose warm waters rise beyond the cultivated plain.
simp_chinese: 桑德克勒坐落在安纳托利亚西部的盆地中，内陆通往爱琴海地区的道路经过这一带。1379年，格尔米扬王朝统治时期，阿拉丁之子巴哈丁·厄梅尔出资修建了当地的大清真寺。城镇还以许代温泉闻名，温热的泉水从耕作平原之外涌出。

english: The mountains around Sandıklı rise above the inland plains southwest of Afyon. Akdağ to the south carries forests and high pastures, while the Kumalar range borders the plain to the east. Limestone ridges and valleys separate the settlements of Sandıklı from the country around Çivril and Dinar. Snow covers the higher summits in winter, and streams descend toward cultivated land on the basin floor.
simp_chinese: 桑德克勒周围山脉耸立在阿菲永西南的内陆平原之上。南面的阿克山覆盖森林与高山牧场，东侧是库马拉尔山脉。石灰岩山岭和河谷将桑德克勒聚落与奇夫里尔、迪纳尔周边地区隔开。冬季积雪覆盖高峰，溪流从山中流向盆地底部的耕地。

english: Sandnes was a prominent Norse church farm in Greenland's Western Settlement, on a low plain at the head of the Ameralik fjord system. Its buildings included a church, dwellings and barns, surrounded by hayfields used to support livestock through the winter. The farm also took part in the northern hunt: remains of worked walrus tusks point to the preparation of ivory for export. Sandnes connects the pastoral life of the Greenlanders with their long-distance exchange across the North Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 桑内斯是格陵兰北欧西部聚落中一座重要的教堂农场，位于阿梅拉利克峡湾水系内端的低地。建筑包括教堂、住所与畜棚，周围的干草地用于储备牲畜过冬所需的饲料。农场也参与北方狩猎：加工过的海象牙残片表明人们为出口准备象牙。桑内斯将格陵兰人的牧业生活与横越北大西洋的远距离交换联系起来。

sources.title: Archaeological Excavations at Qassiarsuk  Brattahlid E29N Field Report 07.pdf

english: Sandomierz stands on hills above the Vistula in Lesser Poland. It was refounded under Magdeburg law in 1286, and its position on the river helped make it an important centre of trade and administration. After a Lithuanian raid and fire in 1349, King Casimir the Great supported the town's restoration. A royal castle, town hall and collegiate church belonged to the medieval town that emerged in this period. Merchants used the Vistula to connect the surrounding countryside with more distant markets, while the town served as the centre of Sandomierz Voivodeship. Its prosperity suffered during the Swedish invasion known as the Deluge: Swedish troops occupied the town in 1655 and blew up the castle when withdrawing in 1656. After the partitions and subsequent Napoleonic conflicts, Sandomierz became part of the Kingdom of Poland established in 1815. Its churches, market square and surviving castle wing bear witness to several centuries of political and commercial life.
simp_chinese: 桑多梅日位于小波兰维斯瓦河畔的丘陵上。1286年，城镇依据马格德堡法重新建置；河畔位置帮助它成为重要的贸易与行政中心。1349年立陶宛袭击和火灾之后，国王卡齐米日大帝支持城镇重建。王家城堡、市政厅和协同教堂都是这一时期中世纪城镇的一部分。商人利用维斯瓦河把周围农村与更远的市场连接起来，桑多梅日也是同名省的中心。被称为“洪水时代”的瑞典入侵打断了它的繁荣：瑞军于1655年占领城镇，1656年撤退时炸毁了城堡。波兰被瓜分及随后的拿破仑战争之后，桑多梅日成为1815年成立的波兰王国的一部分。教堂、市场广场和城堡幸存的一翼，见证了数百年的政治与商业生活。

english:
Borgo San Donnino grew on the site of the Roman town of Fidentia, between Parma and Piacenza. Its medieval church commemorates Saint Domninus, from whom the town took its name. Destroyed by troops from Parma in 1268, the settlement was rebuilt around the turn of the fourteenth century.

Earlier, Frederick II had freed the town from Parma in 1221, before its later destruction. The Visconti of Milan held Borgo San Donnino intermittently from 1346 to 1447. Their successors, the Sforza, conquered it in 1449 and kept it until 1499. The town then passed through further changes of government before becoming part of the Duchy of Parma and Piacenza in 1556. Its position between these larger cities had long made it a prize in the struggles of the Po Valley.
simp_chinese:
圣多尼诺堡建在罗马城镇菲登蒂亚的旧址上，位于帕尔马与皮亚琴察之间。中世纪教堂纪念圣多米努斯，城镇也以他命名。1268年，帕尔马军队摧毁了这处聚落；十四世纪前后，城镇得到重建。

更早以前，腓特烈二世曾于1221年使城镇摆脱帕尔马的控制，随后它才遭到毁坏。米兰的维斯孔蒂家族从1346年至1447年间断续统治圣多尼诺堡。其继承者斯福尔扎家族于1449年征服此地，掌握到1499年。此后城镇又几经易手，1556年成为帕尔马和皮亚琴察公国的一部分。它位于两座较大城市之间，长期以来是波河平原争斗中的争夺对象。

english: Sandrakatsy lies inland from Madagascar's northeastern coast, among the wooded hills south of Antongil Bay. It belongs to a region associated with the Betsimisaraka, whose communities occupy a long stretch of the eastern seaboard. Rice is cultivated in this humid country, where rivers descend from the highlands towards the Indian Ocean. The hills and forests distinguish the interior around Sandrakatsy from the narrow coastal plain farther east.
simp_chinese: 桑德拉卡齐位于马达加斯加东北海岸的内陆，坐落在安通吉尔湾以南树木繁茂的丘陵间。这片地区与贝齐米萨拉卡人相联系，他们的社群分布在东部海岸的漫长地带。湿润的土地适宜种稻，河流从高地向印度洋流去。丘陵和森林使桑德拉卡齐周边内陆有别于更东面的狭窄海岸平原。

english:
The Sandusky River flows north across Ohio to a broad bay of Lake Erie. Wyandot and Lenape towns stood along its course in the eighteenth century, linked to the lake and the interior by water and overland paths. During the American Revolution, the Sandusky country became a battleground between these communities and American forces advancing from the Ohio frontier.

In 1782 Colonel William Crawford led volunteers against the Indigenous towns on the river. His men found the Wyandot village of Upper Sandusky abandoned, then encountered a force of Wyandot, Lenape and other allies, reinforced by British troops. The Americans withdrew; Crawford was captured during the retreat and killed. The failed expedition left the Sandusky towns beyond American control for the remainder of the war.
simp_chinese:
桑达斯基河向北流过俄亥俄，注入伊利湖宽阔的海湾。十八世纪，怀恩多特人与莱纳佩人的城镇沿河分布，水道与陆路将它们连接到湖区和内陆。美国独立战争期间，桑达斯基地区成为这些社群与从俄亥俄边境推进的美军之间的战场。

1782年，威廉·克劳福德上校率志愿兵进攻河上的原住民城镇。他的部下发现怀恩多特人的上桑达斯基村已被弃置，随后遭遇怀恩多特、莱纳佩等盟军，英国部队也前来增援。美军撤退时，克劳福德被俘并遇害。这次远征失败后，战争余下时间里桑达斯基的城镇仍未落入美国控制。

english: Sanekuy lies in the Bwa country south of the inland Niger delta. Its name recalls Sanibè Dembélé, remembered as the first inhabitant; kuy means a village or quarter in the local Bomu language. According to village tradition, the founding Dembélé family came from Konikuy as hunters, and other families joined them over time. The village’s history is preserved in the names of its lineages and in the farming settlements that grew around it.
simp_chinese: 萨内库伊位于尼日尔河内陆三角洲以南的布瓦地区。村名纪念被视作首位居民的萨尼贝·登贝莱；当地博穆语中的“库伊”意为村庄或街区。村庄传统说，创建者登贝莱家族是来自科尼库伊的猎人，其他家族后来陆续加入。村落的历史保存在各世系名称及周围逐渐形成的农业聚落中。

english: Sanga stands on the crest of the Bandiagara escarpment, above the village of Banani and the plains of Dogon country. Caverns in the cliff preserve traces of the Tellem, the people whom Dogon traditions remember finding there. Archaeologists have recovered Tellem pottery from caves near Sanga, while granaries and buildings occupy recesses high in the rock. Dogon communities settled along the escarpment from the fifteenth century, making villages on the plateau and below its steep face.
simp_chinese: 桑加位于班迪亚加拉断崖的顶部，俯瞰巴纳尼村和多贡地区的平原。崖壁洞穴保存着特莱姆人的遗迹，多贡人的传统记得他们是到来时已居住在此的人。考古学家在桑加附近的洞穴中发现特莱姆陶器，高处的岩壁凹穴中还留有粮仓和建筑。十五世纪起，多贡社群沿断崖定居，在高原上和陡峭崖壁下建立村落。

english: Sanga lies near Quihuhu and Marimba, west of the Cuango basin. Northern Angola's riverside forests form galleries among savanna and woodland; farther east, the Cuango carries highland water towards the Kasai. The forest galleries provide habitat for many birds, including turacos and hornbills.
simp_chinese: 桑加靠近基乌乌和马林巴，位于宽果河流域以西。安哥拉北部的河岸森林在稀树草原和林地之间形成廊道；更东面的宽果河将高地水流带向开赛河。森林廊道是众多鸟类的栖地，包括蕉鹃和犀鸟。

english:
Sanga Pumbo lies on a forested plateau in the Sangha country of the western Congo basin, where a network of rivers drains toward the Congo. The Sangha River and its tributaries cut through the woodland, and their floodplains offered fish, game and fertile land for cassava and plantains. Dry patches of grass on the high ground allowed herders to keep small livestock and cattle, which were valued for bridewealth and exchange.

Communities along these rivers joined by canoe routes, marriage ties and trade in forest products, salt and iron. From the sixteenth century, goods from the Atlantic coast passed inland through a chain of intermediaries, though the Congo forest kept most of the region beyond direct European reach until the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese:
桑加蓬博位于刚果盆地西部桑加一带的森林高原，一系列河流向刚果河方向排水。桑加河及其支流切穿林地，河滩地提供鱼类、猎物和适于种植木薯与大蕉的沃土。高地上的草地允许人们饲养小型家畜和牛群，牛只在聘礼和交换中具有价值。

沿河社群通过独木舟航线、婚姻联系以及林产、盐与铁器的交换彼此相连。十六世纪起，大西洋沿岸的货物经由一连串中间人向内陆传递，但直到十九世纪，多数地区仍在欧洲人的直接控制范围之外。

english: Sangacho is a monastic place in the mountain country of Zayul, where tributaries cut deep ravines through a wooded plateau. Sangacho Dzong was a Gelug monastery, remembered locally as having been founded in about the sixteenth century. Its religious community stood among the valleys and high passes connecting southeastern Tibet with the lands farther south.
simp_chinese: 桑嘎曲位于察隅山地，支流在林木覆盖的高地切出深谷。桑嘎曲宗是一座格鲁派寺院，当地人记述它约建于十六世纪。寺院所处的河谷与高山口，连接着藏地东南部和更南方的地方。

english: Sangage lies on the coast of northern Mozambique, near the river mouths south of Mozambique Island. Its people developed a coastal society related to the Swahili world, speaking a language known as Esangaji. A sultanate emerged here in the seventeenth century, among communities whose trade linked the island and mainland. The sheltered waterways offered access to inland products as well as the routes of the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 桑加热位于莫桑比克北部海岸，在莫桑比克岛以南的河口附近。居民形成与斯瓦希里世界相关的海岸社会，使用称为埃桑加吉的语言。十七世纪，这里出现苏丹国，周围社群的贸易将岛屿与大陆连接起来。避风水道既通向内陆出产，也通向印度洋航路。

english: Sangameshwar lies on a river of the Konkan coast, where the old settlement contains several temples. The waterway offered a harbour and a route inland towards the passes of the Western Ghats. In February 1689 the Maratha ruler Sambhaji halted here with his companion Kavi Kalash and a small escort. A Mughal force under Shaikh Nizam approached by forced marches and surprised them. Both men were taken prisoner and later executed on the orders of Aurangzeb, a severe blow to the Maratha leadership.
simp_chinese: 桑伽梅什瓦尔位于贡坎海岸的一条河流旁，旧聚落中有数座寺庙。水道既提供港湾，也通向西高止山脉的内陆山口。1689年2月，马拉塔统治者桑巴吉与随从卡维·卡拉什及少量护卫在此停留。莫卧儿将领谢赫·尼扎姆率军急行军赶来，突袭并俘获他们。二人后来奉奥朗则布之命被处死，对马拉塔领导层造成沉重打击。

english: The Sangamon River winds through the prairies of central Illinois before joining the Illinois River. Its wooded banks and fertile valley became home to settlements as Americans moved into the region in the early nineteenth century. Among them was New Salem, a small village beside a milldam on the river. In 1831 the young Abraham Lincoln and two companions brought a flatboat down the Sangamon with goods bound for New Orleans. The boat caught on the dam at New Salem before they managed to free it and continue their journey.
simp_chinese: 桑加蒙河蜿蜒穿过伊利诺伊中部的草原，最终汇入伊利诺伊河。十九世纪初，美国人迁入这一地区，在林木覆盖的河岸和肥沃河谷建立聚落。其中包括新塞勒姆，一个位于河上磨坊水坝旁的小村。1831年，年轻的亚伯拉罕·林肯与两名同伴乘平底船沿桑加蒙河运货前往新奥尔良。船在新塞勒姆的水坝上搁住，众人设法将它解脱后才得以继续航程。

english: Sangar lies on the right bank of the Lena, downstream from the meeting of the great river and the Aldan. Around this point the Lena passes from its middle to its lower course, continuing north through the central Yakutian lowland. Its broad valley contains channels and islands, while wooded country extends away from the banks. The river provides a natural route between the interior of Yakutia and the distant Arctic coast.
simp_chinese: 桑加尔位于勒拿河右岸，在大河与阿尔丹河汇合处的下游。勒拿河在这一带从中游进入下游，继续向北穿越雅库特中部低地。宽阔河谷里分布着水道与岛屿，林地从河岸向外延伸。这条大河形成了连接雅库特内陆与遥远北极海岸的天然通路。

english: Sangareya Bay opens onto the mangrove-lined rivers of the Upper Guinea coast. Nearby, the Rio Pongo joined an older exchange between coastal Baga communities and the Fula of the interior. At the end of the eighteenth century European and Afro-European traders established themselves near its mouth, and the river became a major outlet for the Atlantic trade in captive people. Merchants and local chiefs resisted attempts by the Sierra Leone Company to take control of the commerce and oppose the slave trade.
simp_chinese: 桑加雷亚湾通向上几内亚海岸红树林环绕的河流。附近的蓬戈河原已连接沿海巴加社群与内陆富拉人的交换网络。十八世纪末，欧洲和非欧混血商人在河口附近落脚，这条河成为大西洋被俘人口贸易的重要出口。塞拉利昂公司试图控制当地商业并反对奴隶贸易，商人和地方首领则共同抵制。

english: Near Sangata on eastern Borneo, lowland forest stretches inland from the Makassar Strait. The Sangatta River crosses this country towards the coast, south of the limestone hills around Bengalon. Orangutans inhabit the forests of Kutai, where mangrove and freshwater swamp lie alongside dry lowland woodland.
simp_chinese: 在婆罗洲东部桑加塔附近，低地森林从望加锡海峡向内陆延伸。桑加塔河穿过这片地区流向海岸，北面则是本加隆附近的石灰岩丘陵。猩猩生活在库泰的森林中，红树林和淡水沼泽与干燥的低地林地并存。

english: The country east of Sangay descends from the volcanic Andes into the forested basin of the upper Amazon. Rivers cut through steep slopes below the volcano, joining the great waterways that flow east. This is part of the ancestral country of the Shuar, whose resistance to Spanish colonial expansion included attacks on settlements in the region in 1599.
simp_chinese: 桑盖以东的地区从火山遍布的安第斯山脉下降，进入亚马孙上游森林流域。河流切过火山下方的陡坡，汇入向东流去的大水系。这里是舒阿尔人的祖地之一；1599年，他们袭击了当地西班牙聚落，反抗不断扩张的殖民统治。

english: The forests around Sangay cloak the eastern slopes of the Ecuadorian Andes. Above them lie cloud forest and high páramo, while rivers descend swiftly towards the Amazon basin. The active volcano at the heart of this landscape has repeatedly covered parts of its surroundings with ash, creating ground on which vegetation must establish itself again. Bears and mountain tapirs inhabit the varied mountain country.
simp_chinese: 桑盖周围的森林覆盖着厄瓜多尔安第斯东坡。森林之上是云雾林与高寒帕拉莫草地，河流则迅速流向亚马孙流域。地处其间的活火山多次以火山灰覆盖周围部分地区，植物必须重新在这些土地上生长。眼镜熊和山貘栖息在这片多样的山地之中。

english: Sangay rises on the eastern edge of the Ecuadorian Andes, above forests and rivers flowing towards the Amazon. This steep volcano is among the most active in the northern Andes. Its first documented eruption was reported in 1628, when ash travelled northwest as far as the region of Riobamba. Activity was again reported from 1728, making the mountain a persistent source of fire and ash in the highlands.
simp_chinese: 桑盖火山耸立于厄瓜多尔安第斯东缘，俯瞰森林和流向亚马孙的河流。这座陡峭的火山是北安第斯最活跃的火山之一。1628年首次有喷发记载，火山灰向西北飘至里奥班巴地区。1728年起又有活动记录，山峰不断为高地带来火光与灰烬。

english: Sangcharak lies among the narrow valleys southeast of Sar-e Pol. The Ab-i Sya and other streams flow out of the highlands into the Sar-e Pol watershed, descending toward the northern Afghan plains. The valleys divide the surrounding mountains into a succession of ridges, with cultivated land concentrated beside the water. Farther north the Sar-e Pol River divides as it enters the lower country, carrying the mountain waters toward the settlements around Sheberghan.
simp_chinese: 桑查拉克位于萨尔普勒东南方狭窄的山谷之间。阿比西亚河等溪流从高地流入萨尔普勒河流域，向阿富汗北部平原下降。河谷将周围群山分成一道道山脊，耕地集中在水边。更北面，萨尔普勒河进入低地时分流，将山中水流带向希比尔甘附近的聚落。

english: Sangerhausen lies southeast of the Harz and appears in records of Fulda Abbey between 780 and 802. The settlement passed through several hands, including the landgraves of Thuringia and the margraves of Brandenburg. In 1372 it was sold to the Wettin rulers of Saxony, who gradually restricted the town's self-government. Its old town hall was rebuilt in stone between 1431 and 1437 after an earlier building burned. Sangerhausen remained part of Saxony until 1815, when the settlement after the Napoleonic wars placed it under Prussian rule.
simp_chinese: 桑格豪森位于哈茨山以东南，780至802年间便出现在富尔达修道院的记录中。聚落曾先后归属图林根伯爵和勃兰登堡藩侯等统治者。1372年，它被卖给萨克森的韦廷家族，后者逐步限制城镇自治。旧市政厅在此前一座建筑被烧毁后，于1431至1437年以石材重建。桑格豪森一直属于萨克森，直到1815年拿破仑战争后的安排将其划归普鲁士。

english: Sanggau lies on the Kapuas River in western Borneo, where the Sekayam joins the great waterway. Local tradition remembers Dara Nante as an early ruler of the Sanggau kingdom, whose origins are preserved chiefly in genealogies and stories. The ruling families of Sanggau and neighboring Kapuas states formed ties through marriage, while the river linked their inland courts with the coast downstream.
simp_chinese: 桑高位于婆罗洲西部卡普阿斯河畔，瑟卡扬河在此汇入这条大水道。当地传统将达拉·南特记作桑高王国的早期统治者，王国起源主要保存在世系与故事之中。桑高与邻近卡普阿斯诸国的统治家族通过婚姻建立联系，河流则将内陆宫廷与下游海岸连接起来。

english: Sangha lies in the upper basin of the river, near Sosso-Nakombo and west of the Mambéré. The Kadeï and Mambéré join farther south at Nola to form the Sangha. Gbaya villages along the upper basin's trails cultivated crops and were grouped under chiefs who maintained relations with neighbouring peoples.
simp_chinese: 桑加位于桑加河上游流域，靠近索索－纳孔博，在曼贝雷河以西。卡代河与曼贝雷河在更南面的诺拉汇合，形成桑加河。上游道路沿线的巴亚人村落种植作物，村落由首领组织，并与邻近人群保持联系。

english: The Sangihe Islands form a chain between northern Sulawesi and Mindanao, with volcanic peaks rising above the seas. Siau and Tagulandang lie along the route between the larger island of Sangir and the coast near Manado, offering stopping places for voyages through the archipelago. Fertile volcanic soils support coconut palms on the lower coastal slopes. The sea joins the islands to their neighbours, though travel by boat remains at the mercy of wind and weather.
simp_chinese: 桑义赫群岛排列在苏拉威西北部与棉兰老岛之间，火山峰峦高出海面。锡奥和塔古兰当位于较大的桑义赫岛与万鸦老附近海岸之间，为穿行群岛的航船提供停靠之处。肥沃的火山土壤使低处海岸山坡适宜椰树生长。海洋将诸岛与邻地相连，船只航行却仍要受风浪天气左右。

english: Sangiin Dalai lies amid the eastern Mongolian grasslands, north of the Xilingol steppe. This open country of pasture and low hills extends towards the volcanic landscape of Dariganga. The Dariganga Mongols are associated with Dari Ovoo and Lake Ganga; among their ancestors were people moved from Chahar, Khalkha and Ööled communities in the late seventeenth century to look after the Qing emperor's horses.
simp_chinese: 桑金达赖位于蒙古东部草原，地处锡林郭勒草原以北。牧场与低丘组成的开阔土地向达里甘嘎火山地貌延伸。达里甘嘎蒙古人与达里敖包和岗嘎湖一带关系密切；其祖先中有十七世纪末从察哈尔、喀尔喀和厄鲁特等群体迁来，为清朝皇帝牧养马群的人们。

english:
Sangju lies in the inland country of southeastern Korea. Its importance as an administrative centre reaches back to Silla, when it governed one of the kingdom's provinces and controlled a route connecting the Han River valley with the Gyeongju area. The name Gyeongsang, applied to the province in 1314, combined the names of Gyeongju and Sangju.

Under the Joseon dynasty Sangju housed the provincial governor's headquarters and stood on the important Yeongnam road. During the Japanese invasion in 1592, Korean forces under Yi Il were defeated at Bukcheon and Sangju fortress surrendered. The provincial headquarters was moved during the war; schools and academies remained important institutions of local Confucian education.
simp_chinese:
尚州位于朝鲜半岛东南部内陆。它作为行政中心的重要性可追溯至新罗时期：当时尚州为一州治所，控制连接汉江流域与庆州地区的道路。1314年形成的庆尚道名称，取自庆州和尚州两地。

朝鲜王朝时期，尚州设有庆尚道观察使的营署，又处于岭南大道的要冲。1592年日本入侵时，李镒率领的朝鲜军在北川战败，尚州城随之投降。战时道营曾迁移；乡校和书院则是当地儒学教育的重要机构。

english: Sangkha lies near the northern foothills of the Dangrek Mountains, in a region with old Khmer monuments and communities skilled in handling elephants. In 1759 Chiang Kha and his followers helped capture a white elephant that had escaped from Ayutthaya. His settlement became the town of Sangkha, one of several local centres owing tribute through Phimai. Elephants and other products of the forests formed part of the tribute sent to the Siamese court.
simp_chinese: 桑卡位于扁担山脉北麓附近，当地既有古老的高棉遗迹，也有擅长驯象的社群。1759年，蒋卡与追随者协助捕回一头从大城逃走的白象。他的聚落后来成为桑卡城，是经披迈向暹罗进贡的几个地方中心之一。大象与其他林地物产都是送往暹罗王廷的贡品。

english: Sangkulirang Bay indents the eastern coast of Borneo south of the Mangkalihat Peninsula. It opens towards the Makassar Strait, the sea passage between Borneo and Sulawesi. Behind the coast rise limestone landscapes of the Sangkulirang–Mangkalihat region, where caves preserve traces of ancient human presence.
simp_chinese: 桑库利朗湾凹入婆罗洲东岸，位于芒卡利哈特半岛以南。海湾向望加锡海峡敞开，海峡分隔婆罗洲与苏拉威西。海岸后方耸立着桑库利朗—芒卡利哈特石灰岩地貌，洞穴中保存着古代人类活动的痕迹。

english:
Sangliat Dol is a village on Yamdena in the Tanimbar Islands of southeastern Indonesia. Steps rise from the shore toward the village, reflecting the close relationship between its cliff-top setting and the sea.

The village is known for a boat-shaped stone ceremonial platform, part of a wider Tanimbar tradition of communal stone spaces. Its carved prow and stern evoke a vessel; oral traditions tell of ancestors arriving by boat. Such platforms were associated with ritual officials, offerings and events that brought villages together.
simp_chinese:
桑利亚多尔是印度尼西亚东南部塔宁巴尔群岛亚姆德纳岛上的村庄。石阶从海岸通向村落，体现了崖顶聚落与海洋之间的密切联系。

村中以船形石造仪式平台闻名，这属于塔宁巴尔共有石质公共空间传统的一部分。平台雕刻船首和船尾，口头传说则讲述祖先乘船而来。这类平台与仪式主持者、供献以及凝聚村社的活动有关。

english: Mount Genyen rises above the valleys of western Sichuan, its snowy summit sacred to people of the surrounding Tibetan country. Between Genyen and neighbouring Xiaoza stands Lenggu Monastery, founded in the twelfth century. It belonged to the Karma Kagyu tradition before later adopting the Gelug school.
simp_chinese: 格聂山耸立在川西群谷之上，积雪的山峰为周围藏族社群奉为神山。格聂与肖扎山之间坐落着十二世纪创建的冷古寺，寺院早年属噶玛噶举派，后来改宗格鲁派。

english:
Sangmelima lies in the forest country of southern Cameroon, within the equatorial forest that stretches north toward the Gabon border. Streams cut the dense woodland into valleys, and villages sat in clearings where cassava, plantains and cocoyam were grown. Hunters ranged the forest for antelope and small game, while women and children gathered honey, nuts, palm products and medicinal bark.

The Bulu, who speak a language of the Beti group, spread through this forest over several centuries. Their villages were built around lineages, with elders settling disputes and allocating farmland. Forest products moved along paths and rivers toward the trading places of the Sanaga and Ntem valleys, where traders exchanged them for salt, iron and cloth.
simp_chinese:
桑梅利马位于喀麦隆南部的森林地带，属于加蓬以北延伸的赤道森林。溪流把密林切割成一道道河谷，村落散布在开垦出的空地上，种植木薯、大蕉和芋头。猎人在林中追踪羚羊与小型猎物，妇女和孩子则采集蜂蜜、坚果、棕榈产品和药用树皮。

布卢人讲贝蒂语支的语言，数个世纪间逐步扩散到这片森林。其村落以宗族为单位组织，长者裁决纠纷并分配耕地。林产品沿小径和河流运往萨纳加河与恩特姆河谷的交易点，商人以之交换盐、铁器和布匹。

english: Sangni stands near Takal in the hill country of northern Punjab. Its fort was built during the Sikh period, after the surrounding area came under Maharaja Ranjit Singh in 1814. The fortress helped its rulers control the district and collect revenue. Within its walls stands a shrine associated with Sahibzada Abdul Hakeem.
simp_chinese: 桑尼位于旁遮普北部山地，靠近塔卡尔。1814年，周围地区归入兰吉特·辛格大君治下；桑尼堡随后建于锡克时期，帮助统治者控制地方、征收税赋。城墙内有一座与萨希卜扎达·阿卜杜勒·哈基姆有关的圣祠。

english: The southern Sea of Okhotsk lies between the coast of Ezo and the Kuril island chain. Its cold waters are reached by seasonal drift ice from the north. Winds and currents can carry ice southward from Sakhalin and then northeast along the islands; some floes pass through the straits into the Pacific. Fog and winter gales add to the hazards of travel in this northern sea.
simp_chinese: 鄂霍次克海南部位于虾夷地海岸与千岛群岛之间，寒冷水域会迎来北方漂来的季节性海冰。风和洋流可将桦太附近的冰向南带，再沿岛链推向东北；部分浮冰穿过海峡进入太平洋。浓雾和冬季大风也使这片北方海域的航行更为艰险。

english: Sangqu is the Tibetan name of the Daxia River, an upper Yellow River tributary rising in the mountains southwest of Labrang. The river crosses the Sangke grasslands and flows through the Labrang valley before descending toward the Yellow River. Its waters gather numerous mountain streams, including the Ge and Yangqu. An older Chinese name for the river was Lishui; in Tibetan tradition its name is also linked to the Sangke grassland and the story of King Gesar.
simp_chinese: 桑曲是大夏河的藏语名称。大夏河为黄河上游支流，发源于拉卜楞西南的山地，流经桑科草原与拉卜楞河谷，再向黄河流去。沿途众多山溪汇入，包括格河与央曲河。大夏河古称漓水；藏地传说则将桑曲之名与桑科草原及格萨尔王的故事联系在一起。

english: Sangüesa stands beside the Aragón River on the pilgrimage road entering Navarre from Jaca and the pass of Somport. The kings of Navarre encouraged settlement here, and hospitals cared for the pilgrims who passed through its streets. During the Peninsular War, in 1812, the guerrilla leader Francisco Espoz y Mina defeated a French force near Rocaforte as it sought to reach Sangüesa.
simp_chinese: 桑圭萨位于阿拉贡河畔，朝圣道路从哈卡和松波尔山口进入纳瓦拉后经过此地。纳瓦拉国王鼓励在这里定居，医院则照料穿行街巷的朝圣者。半岛战争期间，游击队领袖弗朗西斯科·埃斯波斯-伊米纳于1812年在罗卡福尔特附近击败了一支试图前往桑圭萨的法军。

english: Sangvor occupies the mountain country of the Khingob valley, north of the Darvaz Range. The Khingob flows west to join the Vakhsh, while high passes lead south across the mountains towards Darvaz and Khovaling. Winters are cold in these uplands, but the valleys support orchards of apple, pear, apricot and walnut. Above them rise the rugged ridges that separate the Khingob from the valleys of the Vanj and Panj.
simp_chinese: 桑沃尔位于达尔瓦兹山脉以北的欣戈布河谷山区。欣戈布河向西流入瓦赫什河，高山隘口则向南通往达尔瓦兹和霍瓦灵。高地冬季寒冷，河谷中却有苹果、梨、杏和核桃果园。谷地上方是崎岖的山岭，将欣戈布河与万奇河、喷赤河的河谷分隔开来。

english: Sanhe stands where the Ting, Mei and Meitan rivers meet to form the Han River. This junction made the town a stopping place for boats travelling between the inland valleys and Chaozhou downstream. Ming authorities maintained a patrol office and a station here; in 1563 they built a walled post and stationed troops to guard it. The meeting of the rivers gave the settlement both its name and its strategic importance.
simp_chinese: 三河位于汀江、梅江与梅潭河汇合之处，三水合流后称韩江。往来内陆河谷与下游潮州的船只在此停靠。明代官府在三河设置巡检司和驿站，1563年又筑司城、驻兵防守。河流的交汇既赋予此地名称，也使它成为要地。

english: Sanhe lies east of Beijing, between the plain and the hills leading toward Jizhou. Its name means “three rivers,” traditionally referring to the Qidu, Baoqiu and Ju rivers of the surrounding district. A walled town was built here in 932 against Khitan incursions. Under the Ming and Qing, Sanhe remained a county in the capital region, its lands extending across river valleys and foothills.
simp_chinese: 三河位于北京以东的平原与蓟州山麓之间。县名意为“三条河”，传统上指附近的七渡、鲍邱和泃河。932年，地方在此筑城防御契丹；明清时期，三河仍是京畿一县，辖境横跨河谷与山麓。

english:
The Belcher Islands lie in the southeastern waters of Hudson Bay, a maze of low islands and channels inhabited by Inuit for centuries. Archaeological sites also bear traces of Dorset and Thule peoples. Seals and eider ducks provided food and materials, while journeys to the mainland linked the islanders to other communities across the bay.

Henry Hudson sighted the islands in 1610. From around 1749 many islanders made annual visits to the Hudson's Bay Company post at the mouth of the Great Whale River to trade and meet others on the mainland. In winter they crossed the ice by dog team and sled; in summer they could make the hazardous passage by kayak. Sealskins were among the goods they carried to exchange.
simp_chinese:
贝尔彻群岛散布在哈得孙湾东南部，低矮岛屿与水道交织如迷宫。因纽特人几个世纪以来在此生活，考古遗址还留有多塞特人与图勒人的痕迹。海豹和绒鸭提供食物与材料，前往大陆的旅程则将岛民同其他社群联系起来。

1610年，亨利·哈得孙望见这些岛屿。约从1749年起，许多岛民每年到大鲸河口的哈得孙湾公司商站交易、会面。冬季他们乘狗拉雪橇越过冰面，夏季则可驾驶皮艇完成危险的水上航程。海豹皮是他们带去交换的物品之一。

english: Sānjiǎochéng lies in the Qilian mountains of the Amdo borderlands, where valleys and high pasture connect farming and herding communities. It is a cold, sparsely settled country of peaks and grassland, where sheltered valleys supported small plots of farmland and herders moved their flocks between seasonal pastures.
simp_chinese: 三角城位于青藏东北安多地区的祁连山区，河谷与高地牧场连接农业和牧业社群。这里寒冷而人口稀少，山峰与草原交错，背风的河谷可耕种小块田地，牧民则在季节牧场之间转移畜群。

english: Sanju stands at the northern approach to the Kunlun Mountains, south of the Yarkand oasis. The Sanju Pass was one of the routes used by caravans travelling between Yarkand and Ladakh. Beyond it lay the difficult road to Shahidulla, a meeting point for several tracks through the mountains, before the journey continued toward Leh. Qing maps and records preserve the names of stations along this long route across the high ranges.
simp_chinese: 桑株位于叶尔羌绿洲以南、昆仑山北面的入口。桑株达坂是叶尔羌与拉达克之间商队所用的道路之一。翻越山口之后，艰险山路通向赛图拉，数条穿山道路在此汇合，旅人再继续前往列城。清代地图和文献保存着这条漫长山路沿途一些站点的名称。

english: The Sankamphaeng Mountains rise between the eastern Thai plains and the Khorat Plateau. Their northern end joins the Dong Phaya Yen range, forming a forested escarpment above the lowlands. Rivers cut through the rugged slopes, and tropical forest covers much of the high ground. Together these mountain chains make a natural divide between the Chao Phraya and Bang Pakong basins to the west and south and the plateau country to the northeast.
simp_chinese: 山甘烹山脉耸立在泰国东部平原与呵叻高原之间。山脉北端与栋帕耶延山脉相接，在低地上方形成森林覆盖的陡坡。河流切穿崎岖的山坡，热带森林覆盖大片高地。这些山脉共同构成一道天然分界，分隔西面和南面的湄南河、挽巴功河流域与东北方的高原地带。

english: Sankancete is remembered as a Huarpe chief whose name is associated with Caucete, east of the San Juan valley. The surrounding country lies between the Andean foothills and the dry plains of Cuyo. Huarpe communities occupied the valleys and waterways of the region before Spanish settlement, cultivating land where irrigation was possible and using the resources of the neighbouring wetlands. Their lands were drawn into the colonial jurisdiction of Cuyo in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 桑坎塞特被记作一位瓦尔佩首领，其名字与圣胡安河谷以东的考塞特有关。周围地带位于安第斯山麓与库约干旱平原之间。西班牙人定居之前，瓦尔佩社群生活在这一地区的河谷和水道旁，在可以灌溉的地方耕作，并利用附近湿地的资源。十六世纪，他们的土地被纳入殖民时期的库约辖区。

english: Sankaranayinarkoil takes its name from the temple of Sankaranarayana, a deity combining Shiva and Vishnu in one form. The shrine also honours the goddess Gomathi Amman, whose penance is connected with the appearance of the united deity in local tradition. Tradition attributes the foundation to a Pandya ruler, while later patrons enlarged the temple. Its tall gateway and sacred tank made the temple a prominent landmark in the surrounding Tamil country.
simp_chinese: 桑卡拉纳伊纳科伊尔得名于桑卡拉纳拉亚纳神庙，神庙供奉湿婆与毗湿奴合为一体的神祇。圣所也尊奉女神戈马蒂·安曼；当地传说将她的苦修与这一合体神祇的显现联系起来。传统将神庙的创建归于一位潘迪亚统治者，后世赞助者又扩建了建筑。高耸门塔与圣池使神庙成为周围泰米尔地区醒目的地标。

english: The Sankina is a left-bank tributary of the Tura in the forested country east of the Urals. The Tura flows onward to the Tobol and the Irtysh, linking this river network with western Siberia. On the Tura, the Russian stockade of Turinsk was founded in 1600 to guard the route between Verkhoturye and Tyumen. Farther into the forests, the Sankina and its smaller tributaries drain the country north of that route.
simp_chinese: 桑基纳河是乌拉尔山东侧林地中图拉河的一条左岸支流。图拉河继续流向托博尔河和额尔齐斯河，将这一水网与西西伯利亚联系起来。1600年，俄罗斯人在图拉河上建立图林斯克木堡，守卫韦尔霍图里耶与秋明之间的道路；更深入森林的桑基纳河及其小支流则汇集这条路线以北地区的水。

english:
Borgo San Lorenzo lies in the Mugello valley north of Florence, beside the Sieve River. Its market served the fertile countryside, and roads through the Tuscan hills connected the town with Florence and neighbouring districts. The parish church of San Lorenzo was an established centre of local religious life.

Once a possession of the bishop of Florence, Borgo came under Florentine authority. In 1351 the Florentine republic fortified the settlement with walls and gates, including the Porta Fiorentina and the gate now known for its clock. The defences gave the valley's market town a place in Florence's wider system of protecting and governing its surrounding territory.
simp_chinese:
圣洛伦佐位于佛罗伦萨以北的穆杰洛河谷，坐落在西耶韦河畔。城镇市场服务着肥沃的乡村，穿过托斯卡纳丘陵的道路将它与佛罗伦萨及邻近地区相连。圣洛伦佐教区教堂则是地方宗教生活的中心。

这座城镇曾属佛罗伦萨主教，后来进入佛罗伦萨的管辖。1351年，佛罗伦萨共和国修筑城墙和城门，其中包括佛罗伦萨门和后来以钟楼闻名的城门。这些防御工事将河谷集镇纳入佛罗伦萨保护和治理周边领地的体系。

english: Sanlúcar de Barrameda stands at the mouth of the Guadalquivir, where ships sailing to and from Seville met the Atlantic. Held by the dukes of Medina Sidonia, the port prospered as fleets bound for the Americas gathered and made their final preparations here. On 20 September 1519 five ships departed Sanlúcar under Ferdinand Magellan in search of a route to the Spice Islands. Nearly three years later only the Victoria returned, commanded by Juan Sebastián Elcano. Its surviving crew had completed the first voyage around the world.
simp_chinese: 桑卢卡尔德巴拉梅达位于瓜达尔基维尔河口，往返塞维利亚的船只在此进入大西洋。港口属于梅迪纳-西多尼亚公爵，开往美洲的舰队在这里集结、作最后准备，使城镇繁荣起来。1519年9月20日，斐迪南·麦哲伦率领五艘船从桑卢卡尔出发，寻找通往香料群岛的航路。近三年后，只有胡安·塞瓦斯蒂安·埃尔卡诺指挥的“维多利亚”号归来。幸存船员完成了首次环球航行。

english: Sanlúcar la Mayor stands west of Seville in the Aljarafe, a district of rolling farmland above the Guadiamar. Its old walls and gates recall a fortified town that passed from Muslim to Castilian rule during the conquest of the region in the thirteenth century. The churches and streets within the enclosure preserve traces of the communities that lived here through succeeding centuries.
simp_chinese: 大桑卢卡尔位于塞维利亚以西的阿尔哈拉费地区，瓜迪亚马尔河上方起伏的农田环绕着城镇。古老城墙和城门令人想起这座设防城镇：13世纪该地区被征服期间，它从穆斯林转入卡斯蒂利亚统治。城墙内的教堂与街巷保留着此后数世纪居民生活的痕迹。

english: Sànmáo was a hereditary chiefship in the mountains of southwestern Hubei, ruled by the Qín family. Its territory covered the country around later Láifèng and extended into neighbouring valleys. The Ming raised the office to a pacification commission in 1415, under Shīzhōu Guard. It survived into the Qing, but in 1735 the government replaced the hereditary chiefship with appointed officials and established Láifèng County. The old chief's seat remained a reminder of the long era of native rule.
simp_chinese: 散毛是湖北西南山地的世袭土司，由覃氏掌管，辖地包括后来来凤一带及邻近山谷。明永乐十三年（1415年），散毛长官司升为宣抚司，隶属施州卫。土司制度延续到清代，雍正十三年（1735年）改土归流，设来凤县，旧司城留下了世袭地方政权的记忆。

english:
Sanmen Bay indents the Zhejiang coast between Ningbo and Taizhou, where islands and tidal channels separate the mainland from the East China Sea. Fishing and coastal transport connected communities around the bay and with neighboring districts. Its shores also supported salt production, an important source of revenue in the region.

The Changting salt works included production areas along the shore, while Dudu was another important salt-producing district to the south. In 1109 the Changting works moved its administrative seat from Gangtou to Changting. During the Ming and Qing periods, fishing, agriculture and sea traffic continued alongside salt making, within a coastal landscape subject to official regulation and concern for defense.
simp_chinese:
三门湾深入浙江海岸，位于宁波与台州之间，岛屿和潮汐水道将大陆与东海连接起来。捕鱼与沿岸运输联系着湾内及邻近地区的社群。沿岸也有盐业生产，是当地赋税的重要来源。

长亭盐场的产区沿岸分布，南面的杜渎场也是重要盐区。1109年，长亭盐场的场署由港头迁往长亭。明清时期，捕鱼、农业和海上交通与制盐并存，沿海生活也受到官方管理和海防事务影响。

english: Sanniquellie lies in the country west of the Nimba mountains, where forested hills rise above the savanna and river valleys of the interior. Mano and Gio communities inhabit this region, speaking related Mande languages and maintaining traditions of farming and village life. The Nimba range forms a striking landmark above the surrounding country, with streams descending from its slopes towards the rivers of the Guinea highlands and the Atlantic coast.
simp_chinese: 桑尼奎利位于宁巴山脉以西，森林覆盖的丘陵高出内陆草原与河谷。马诺人和焦人居住在这一地区，使用彼此相关的曼德语，并维持农耕与村落生活的传统。宁巴山脉耸立在周围土地之上，是醒目的地标；溪流从山坡流下，汇入几内亚高地和大西洋沿岸的河川。

english: Sanok stands on the San beside the Carpathian Mountains, on a route towards Hungary. The Hypatian Chronicle records the capture of its stronghold by King Géza II of Hungary in 1150 and later calls it the Hungarian Gate. In 1339 Bolesław-Yuri II of Galicia granted the town Magdeburg law; King Casimir III confirmed its status in 1366. Sanok became a royal town and the administrative and judicial centre of its own district within the Ruthenian Voivodeship.
simp_chinese: 萨诺克位于桑河畔、喀尔巴阡山旁，处于通往匈牙利的道路上。《伊帕季编年史》记载匈牙利国王盖萨二世于1150年夺取这里的要塞，后来又称其为“匈牙利门户”。1339年，加利西亚的博列斯瓦夫－尤里二世授予城镇马格德堡法权；卡齐米日三世国王于1366年确认其地位。萨诺克成为王室城镇，也是鲁塞尼亚省内同名地区的行政和司法中心。

english: Sanrao lies in the hill country of eastern Guangdong, near the border with Fujian. It became the seat of Raoping County, established under the Ming in 1476. Nearby stands Daoyun Lou, a vast octagonal fortified residence built by the Huang lineage. The family began construction in 1477 and completed the building in 1587, after generations of work. Its thick earthen walls enclosed homes arranged around inner courts, offering a large household both living space and protection in a region where raids and local conflicts were feared.
simp_chinese: 三饶位于广东东部山区，邻近福建。明朝1476年设饶平县，以三饶为治所。附近黄氏家族修建的道韵楼是一座规模宏大的八角形围楼。 黄氏于1477年动工，经过几代人的努力，直到1587年才建成。厚实的土墙围合住宅与院落，既供族人居住，也在盗匪和地方冲突令人不安的年代提供防护。

english:
Sansanding stands on the Niger downstream from Ségou, in the heart of the riverine trading country. Its market drew merchants from the Sahara as well as from towns and villages along the Niger. The Scottish traveller Mungo Park found a large and busy town here in 1796, where traders exchanged goods from the north for gold and cotton.

Park returned in 1805 and spent several weeks at Sansanding preparing boats and supplies for his last journey down the Niger, a voyage from which he would not return. In the following decades conflict between the rulers of Ségou and the state of Masina disrupted routes farther downstream. Sansanding benefited from the resulting changes in trade and became one of the most important markets of the region.
simp_chinese:
桑桑丁位于尼日尔河畔、塞古下游，是河上贸易地区的中心之一。市场吸引了来自撒哈拉以及尼日尔河沿岸城镇的商人。1796年，苏格兰旅行者蒙戈·帕克到访时，见到一座繁忙的大城，商人用北方货物交换黄金和棉花。

1805年帕克再次来到桑桑丁，停留数周准备船只，开始他最后一次沿尼日尔河的旅程。此后数十年，塞古统治者与马西纳国家之间的冲突扰乱了下游道路。贸易路线随之变化，桑桑丁从中受益，成为地区最重要的市场之一。

english: Sansanné-Mango stands on the Oti River in the northern savanna, at a crossing of routes between the Niger country and the kola-producing lands farther south. The Anufom established a political centre here, choosing a site already used by Hausa caravans travelling towards southern markets. Merchants and religious specialists contributed to the town’s life, while the Oti and surrounding plains supported farming communities. Its position made it a meeting place of several peoples and trading traditions.
simp_chinese: 桑桑内芒戈坐落在北部草原的奥蒂河畔，处在尼日尔地区与南方可乐果产地之间的道路交汇处。阿努福人在这里建立政治中心，所选地点此前已是豪萨商队前往南方市场的歇脚站。商人与宗教人士参与城镇生活，奥蒂河和周围平原则供养农业社群。这里成为多个族群和贸易传统相遇的地方。

english:
Sansepolcro lies in the upper Tiber valley, where a settlement grew around a monastery dedicated to the Holy Sepulchre. Tradition attributed its foundation to pilgrims returning from Jerusalem. The town was the birthplace of the painter Piero della Francesca and the mathematician Luca Pacioli, whose work reflects its place in the learning and art of the Renaissance.

In 1367 Pope Urban V granted Sansepolcro and its territory to the Malatesta family. Their heirs held the town and its surrounding lands until Florence gained control in the fifteenth century with papal approval. Piero della Francesca painted for his native town as well as for patrons elsewhere in Italy. In the sixteenth century Pope Leo X raised Sansepolcro to the rank of a city.
simp_chinese:
圣塞波尔克罗位于台伯河上游谷地，聚落围绕一座献给圣墓的修道院发展。传统认为它由从耶路撒冷归来的朝圣者建立。画家皮耶罗·德拉弗朗切斯卡和数学家卢卡·帕乔利都出生于此，他们的作品体现了这座城镇在文艺复兴学术与艺术中的地位。

1367年，教皇乌尔班五世将圣塞波尔克罗及其领地授予马拉泰斯塔家族。家族继承人一直持有此地，直到十五世纪佛罗伦萨在教皇同意下取得控制权。皮耶罗·德拉弗朗切斯卡不仅为意大利各地的赞助人作画，也为家乡创作。十六世纪，教皇良十世将圣塞波尔克罗升为城市。

english:
San Severo stands on the fertile Tavoliere plain of northern Apulia, between the Gargano and the Apennines. In the sixteenth century it was an important centre of provincial government, housing the governor and the royal court of justice for Capitanata and Molise. Its location on the plain brought the surrounding agricultural country into contact with the town and its officials. Churches and merchants' houses gave it a stature matching its administrative role.

In 1579 San Severo was sold to Gian Francesco di Sangro, whose heirs became princes of the town. A devastating earthquake struck on 30 July 1627, badly damaging its medieval streets and buildings. Reconstruction continued into the following century, reshaping the town around churches and public spaces restored after the disaster.
simp_chinese:
圣塞韦罗位于阿普利亚北部肥沃的塔沃利耶雷平原，介于加尔加诺与亚平宁山脉之间。十六世纪，它是省级政府中心，驻有卡皮塔纳塔与莫利塞总督及王室法庭。平原上的位置使周围农业地区与城镇及其官员紧密相连。教堂与商人住宅使城镇面貌与行政地位相称。

1579年，圣塞韦罗被出售给詹·弗朗切斯科·迪桑格罗，其继承人成为当地亲王。1627年7月30日的毁灭性地震严重损坏中世纪街道与建筑。重建持续至下一世纪，城镇围绕灾后修复的教堂和公共空间重新形成。

english: Sansha Bay lies along the deeply indented coast of northeastern Fujian. Its sheltered waters comprise a number of smaller bays and harbours, including Baima, Yantian, Dongwuyang, Guanjingyang, and Sanduao. Headlands and islands divide these inlets, creating a complex coastline with broad stretches of water behind its approaches from the sea.
simp_chinese: 三沙湾位于福建东北部曲折的海岸上。受庇护的水域包含白马港、盐田港、东吾洋、官井洋和三都澳等港湾。岬角和岛屿将这些水域分隔开，构成复杂的海岸线，外海入口之后则展开宽阔的水面。

english: Sanshui takes its name from the meeting of the West, North and Sui rivers, a junction of waterways leading toward Guangzhou and the western interior. The Ming established Sanshui County in 1526, choosing a site at Hekou for its seat; construction of the town walls began the following year. Travelers passed through the river junction in both directions. In 1589 the Jesuit Matteo Ricci and his companions changed boats here on their journey from Zhaoqing to Shaozhou, taking a vessel suited to sailing upstream.
simp_chinese: 三水因西江、北江与绥江交会而得名，水路由此通向广州和西部内地。明朝于1526年设立三水县，以河口为县治，次年开始修筑城墙。往来的旅人常经此水路枢纽。1589年，耶稣会士利玛窦与同伴从肇庆前往韶州时，便在三水换乘适合逆流行驶的船只。

english:
Sānshuǐ lies in the uplands northwest of Bīnzhōu, in the district once called Xúnyì, the old Bin of the Shijing, where the Zhou ancestors are said to have farmed before they moved to the Qi plain. The Qin had a county at Xunyi in the Warring States, and the Han placed it under the metropolitan commandery of the right. In the Northern Dynasties the name Sanshui took its place, and the county kept it through the Sui, Tang, Song and Jin.

In 1270 the Yuan abolished the county and joined its territory to neighbouring Chunhua. The Ming restored Sanshui County in 1477, making it again a separate county of the Binzhou region. In the years of the Ming and Qing it was a hill district of dry-farmed millet and wheat on the road between the Wei plain and the loess north.
simp_chinese:
三水位于邠州西北的高地，这一带古称栒邑，也就是《诗经》里的豳地，相传周人先祖曾在此耕作，后来才迁往岐山之下的周原。战国时秦在栒邑设县，汉代属右扶风。南北朝时改称三水县，隋、唐、宋、金沿用其名。

1270年，元朝撤销三水县，把辖地并入邻近的淳化；明成化十三年（1477年）复设三水县，使这里再次成为邠州一带的独立县治。明清两代，这里是渭北平原与北面黄土高原之间的山区，种植旱地的粟与麦，靠大路与外界相通。

english: Sant Feliu de Guíxols grew beside a sheltered bay around a Benedictine monastery. Its oldest surviving entrance, the Porta Ferrada, was incorporated into a complex enlarged over many centuries. Defensive towers guarded the church: from one, smoke could be raised as a warning, while from another a horn sounded danger. The monastery and its natural harbour gave the coastal town its distinctive character.
simp_chinese: 圣费柳德吉绍尔斯在一处 避风海湾边围绕本笃会修道院发展起来。修道院历经数世纪扩建，最古老的入口铁门也被纳入建筑群。防御塔守护着教堂：一座塔可燃起烟雾发出警报，另一座则用号角示警。修道院与天然港湾共同塑造了这座海滨城镇的风貌。

english: Santa Bárbara grew beside a stream at the foot of the Serra do Caraça in Minas Gerais. In 1704 Antônio Silva Bueno and his companions found gold here, attracting prospectors to the new workings. The settlement developed around a chapel dedicated to Saint Anthony, while the stream and town took the name of Saint Barbara. Its churches and old houses recall the wealth of the mining period.
simp_chinese: 圣巴巴拉兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯卡拉萨山脚下一条溪流旁。1704年，安东尼奥·席尔瓦·布埃诺及其同伴在此发现黄金，吸引寻矿者前来。聚落围绕供奉圣安东尼奥的小教堂发展，溪流与城镇则以圣巴巴拉命名。教堂和老宅保存着矿业时期的财富所留下的印记。

english: The Chumash homeland stretches along the Californian coast from Morro Bay to Malibu and includes the northern Channel Islands. Its people traveled these waters in #italic tomols#!, plank canoes built for journeys between the mainland and islands. Near Point Conception, where the coastline turns eastward toward the Santa Barbara Channel, ocean conditions make the crossing between these shores a demanding one.
simp_chinese: 丘马什人的家园沿加利福尼亚海岸从莫罗湾延伸至马里布，也包括北部海峡群岛。他们乘坐称为#italic 托莫尔#!的木板舟穿行于这些水域，往来于大陆与岛屿之间。在康塞普申角附近，海岸线转向东面，通往圣巴巴拉海峡；此处的海况使两岸之间的航程颇具挑战。

english: Santa Catarina Island lies close to the southern Brazilian mainland, separated from it by narrow waters opening into bays. European ships called here on voyages towards the River Plate. Francisco Dias Velho established a Portuguese settlement on the island in the seventeenth century, later known as Nossa Senhora do Desterro. In the eighteenth century forts guarded its approaches and settlers from the Azores founded communities on the island and adjoining coast.
simp_chinese: 圣卡塔琳娜岛紧邻巴西南部大陆，岛与大陆之间的狭窄水道通向海湾。驶往拉普拉塔河的欧洲船只曾在此停靠。十七世纪，弗朗西斯科·迪亚斯·韦柳在岛上建立葡萄牙聚落，后来称为德斯特罗圣母。十八世纪，堡垒守卫岛屿入口，来自亚速尔群岛的移民也在岛上及邻近海岸建立聚落。

english: The broad waters of Monterey Bay indent the central Californian coast, near the lands of the Rumsen people. In 1602 Sebastián Vizcaíno entered the bay while surveying the coast and judged it a suitable harbor for Spanish ships to rest and take on supplies. Local Rumsen visitors brought shellfish to the expedition. In 1770, the Spanish founded the presidio and Mission San Carlos Borromeo at Monterey.
simp_chinese: 蒙特雷湾宽阔的水面深入加利福尼亚中部海岸，附近是鲁姆森人的土地。1602年，塞瓦斯蒂安·比斯卡伊诺勘察海岸时驶入海湾，认为这里适合西班牙船只休整和补给。当地鲁姆森人到访探险队，并带来了贝类。1770年，西班牙人在蒙特雷建立要塞和圣卡洛斯·博罗梅奥传教站。

sources.title: Part 2 Final GP Ch 02 Existing Cond Summay.pdf

english: Santa Cruz stands on the eastern shore of Flores, one of the westernmost islands of the Azores. The island was settled in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, after an earlier attempt to establish a community had failed. Santa Cruz grew into one of its principal settlements; a document of 1548 refers to it as a town, though the date at which that status was granted is unknown. Its inhabitants lived with the isolation of an island far out in the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 圣克鲁什位于弗洛里什岛东岸；这座岛屿是亚速尔群岛最西部的岛屿之一。早期的定居尝试失败后，移民于十五世纪末和十六世纪初在岛上建立了持久聚落。圣克鲁什逐渐成为岛上的主要聚落之一。1548年的一份文件已称其为市镇，但具体获封日期不详。居民的生活受这座大西洋孤岛的遥远位置所影响。

english: Santa Cruz is a volcanic island near the centre of the Galápagos archipelago. Its dry shores rise towards higher ground, and its tortoises and marine iguanas belong to the distinctive animal life of these remote Pacific islands. In 1832 Ecuador took possession of the archipelago, and settlers later sought land on Santa Cruz. Before permanent settlement, ships visiting the islands collected tortoises and other provisions for long voyages.
simp_chinese: 圣克鲁斯是一座位于加拉帕戈斯群岛中央附近的火山岛。干燥的海岸向高地升起，陆龟和海鬣蜥是这些偏远太平洋岛屿独特动物群的一部分。1832年，厄瓜多尔取得群岛，此后定居者来到圣克鲁斯寻找土地。在永久聚落出现之前，到访的船只会在群岛捕取陆龟和其他补给，以备漫长航行。

english:
The Santa Cruz River reaches the South Atlantic from the Patagonian interior, forming a conspicuous mouth along an exposed coast. Strong tides, winds, shoals and changing currents made entry and anchorage matters requiring care. Indigenous communities in the wider Patagonian country maintained routes and seasonal knowledge connecting inland resources with the shore.

European navigators encountered this coast while exploring the southern Atlantic and routes around South America. It became part of the geographical knowledge of voyages between the Atlantic and Pacific, although permanent colonial occupation remained limited for much of the early modern period. A river mouth could offer fresh water and shelter to ships, alongside hazards to navigation.
simp_chinese:
圣克鲁斯河从巴塔哥尼亚内陆注入南大西洋，在暴露的海岸上形成醒目的河口。强潮、风、浅滩和变化的水流使船只进出及停泊都需要谨慎。巴塔哥尼亚更广大地区的原住民社群，维持着连接内陆资源与海岸的路线及季节知识。

欧洲航海者在探索南大西洋和绕过南美洲的航路时来到这一海岸。这段海岸逐渐被纳入连接大西洋与太平洋的航行地理知识，但近代早期大部分时间里，永久殖民占领仍然有限。河口可能为船只提供淡水和庇护，同时也存在航行危险。

english: Santa Eufemia lies beneath the castle of Miramontes in the northern hills of Córdoba. The town became the centre of a lordship founded at the end of the thirteenth century, encompassing several neighbouring settlements. In 1478 the Catholic Monarchs ordered the castle destroyed to punish abuses by its lord and bring him to obedience, leaving the fortress a reminder of conflict between local power and the crown.
simp_chinese: 圣欧费米娅位于科尔多瓦北部丘陵中，米拉蒙特斯城堡俯瞰城镇。13世纪末，这里成为一片领地的中心，领地包括周围数个聚落。1478年，天主教双王为惩罚当地领主的暴行、迫使其服从，下令毁掉城堡。要塞遗迹令人想起地方权力与王室之间的冲突。

english: The Santa Inés mountains rise in the Central Cordillera of northern Antioquia. Their high ground includes the Belmira–Santa Inés páramo, a cool upland landscape above the surrounding Andean forests. Streams descend from the heights towards valleys on either side of the range. The páramo vegetation and mountain waters distinguish these heights from the lower, warmer country of the Cauca and Nechí basins.
simp_chinese: 圣伊内斯山地耸立在安蒂奥基亚北部的中央科迪勒拉山脉中。高处包括贝尔米拉—圣伊内斯帕拉莫，这片凉冷高地位于周围安第斯森林之上。溪流从山岭向两侧谷地流去。高寒草原植被与山地水源，使这里不同于考卡河和内奇河流域较低、较温暖的地区。

english: Santa Luzia grew beside the Rio das Velhas in the mining country of Minas Gerais. The first nucleus of the settlement was founded by bandeirantes in 1692, during the search for riches in the Brazilian interior. Its older streets and religious buildings recall the community that arose in the following centuries, when the river valley became part of the Portuguese colonial mining region.
simp_chinese: 圣卢西亚兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯矿区的韦利亚斯河畔。1692年，深入巴西内陆寻找财富的班德兰特人在此建立了聚落的最初核心。随着河谷成为葡萄牙殖民地采矿地区的一部分，社区逐渐发展，其老街和宗教建筑保存了这段历史的痕迹。

english: Santa Maria is the southeastern island of the Azores, with a hilly interior above its Atlantic shores. It was the first island of the archipelago to receive a Portuguese settlement, around 1440, under Gonçalo Velho Cabral. Vila do Porto became the first town in the islands. On his return from his first voyage to America in 1493, Christopher Columbus stopped at Santa Maria, where members of his crew went ashore at Anjos.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽亚是亚速尔群岛东南部的岛屿，起伏的内陆高地俯临大西洋海岸。约1440年，贡萨洛·韦略·卡布拉尔率领移民在此建立了群岛首个葡萄牙人聚落，港口镇后来成为群岛最早的市镇。1493年，克里斯托弗·哥伦布从首次美洲航行返程时在圣玛丽亚停泊，他的部分船员在安若什上岸。

english: The bay of Santa Marta lies on Colombia’s northern Caribbean shore beneath the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. The mountains rise close to the sea, giving this coast a striking profile. The Spanish founded Santa Marta in 1525 beside the bay, establishing an early colonial foothold on the South American mainland. Its harbour joined the city to other Caribbean ports and to the maritime routes along the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 圣玛尔塔湾位于哥伦比亚北部加勒比海岸，背靠圣玛尔塔内华达山脉。群山靠近海边拔地而起，使海岸轮廓格外鲜明。西班牙人于1525年在湾旁建立圣玛尔塔，成为南美大陆上的早期殖民据点。港口将城市与其他加勒比港口及北岸航路连接起来。

english: Cape Santa María stands on the Atlantic coast of Uruguay, east of the broad mouth of the Río de la Plata. Its rocky projection and neighbouring bays mark the approach to the estuary for ships sailing along this shore. In the sixteenth century the cape was treated as a gateway to the great river explored by Juan Díaz de Solís.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽亚角位于乌拉圭大西洋海岸，在拉普拉塔河宽阔河口以东。岩石岬角和附近海湾为沿岸航行的船只标示通向河口的路径。十六世纪，海角被视为进入胡安·迪亚斯·德索利斯探索的大河的门户。

english: The waters around Santa Maria surround the southeastern island of the Azores. Portuguese settlers established themselves on the island around 1440 under Gonçalo Velho Cabral, making it the first settled island of the archipelago. In 1493 Christopher Columbus reached Santa Maria on his return from his first voyage to America. Members of his crew went ashore at Anjos, where they sought to give thanks after their dangerous crossing.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽亚岛周围的海水环绕着亚速尔群岛东南端的岛屿。约1440年，葡萄牙移民在贡萨洛·韦略·卡布拉尔率领下在岛上定居，圣玛丽亚由此成为群岛最早有人定居的岛屿。1493年，克里斯托弗·哥伦布结束首次美洲航行返程时抵达这里。部分船员在安若什上岸，为渡海脱险而举行感恩仪式。

english: The sea north of Marajó Island lies at the edge of the vast Amazon estuary. Fresh water and suspended sediment spread outward from the river mouth, while tides sweep across low islands and shallow banks. The northern shore of Marajó faces the southern Amazon channel, and its creeks open onto waters where the river’s seasonal flood and the Atlantic continually meet.
simp_chinese: 马拉若岛以北的海域位于广阔亚马孙河口的边缘。淡水和悬浮泥沙从河口向外扩散，潮汐则掠过低矮岛屿和浅滩。马拉若岛北岸面向亚马孙河南汊，沿岸溪道通向河流季节性洪水与大西洋不断交汇的水域。

english: Santal Bay cuts into the western coast of Lifou, the largest of the Loyalty Islands. Between its headlands the seabed slopes steeply down from a narrow coral-fringed margin. Lifou is the home of Drehu speakers, whose language belongs to the Loyalty Islands group. In 1793 the merchant ship Britannia, under William Raven, mapped Lifou and other islands of the group during a voyage towards Batavia.
simp_chinese: 桑塔尔湾深入洛亚蒂群岛最大岛屿利富的西岸。两侧岬角之间，海床从珊瑚环绕的狭窄边缘陡然下降。利富是德雷胡语使用者的家园，这种语言属于洛亚蒂群岛语支。1793年，威廉·雷文率商船“布里塔尼亚”号驶往巴达维亚途中，测绘了利富及群岛中的其他岛屿。

english: Santana Island lies in the Amazon estuary opposite the northern bank, near the deep channel leading upriver. Its position made the waters around it a point of interest to European powers seeking control of the river mouth. An English fort stood opposite the island in the early seventeenth century, and a settlement developed on the island in the eighteenth century. Wide tidal waters surround its forested banks.
simp_chinese: 圣安娜岛位于亚马孙河口，面对北岸，靠近通向上游的深水道。岛屿的位置使其周围水域受到争夺河口控制权的欧洲势力关注。十七世纪初，英国人在岛对岸设有堡垒；十八世纪，岛上发展出一处聚落。宽阔的潮汐水域环绕着森林覆盖的岛岸。

english:
Santander lies on a sheltered bay of the Cantabrian coast. After the Castilian fleet's victory over the English at La Rochelle in 1372, Henry II entered the port, which became the Atlantic naval base of the crown, with royal shipyards like those of Seville and Barcelona. In 1466 Henry IV gave the town to the Marquis of Santillana. Plague in 1596–97 left only 800 of its 2,500 people.

In 1748 the crown ordered a road built through Reinosa to carry Castile's wool and flour to the port; in 1754 the abbey of the Holy Bodies became a cathedral when Santander became a diocese, and in 1755 Ferdinand VI granted it the title of city. Free trade with Spanish America from 1765 opened its commerce to the Atlantic, and the Consulate of Sea and Land was created in 1783. By the early nineteenth century Santander led the exchanges between the north of the peninsula and the major American ports, and in 1833 it became a provincial capital.
simp_chinese:
桑坦德位于坎塔布里亚海岸一处有遮蔽的海湾。1372年卡斯蒂利亚舰队在拉罗谢尔战胜英军后，恩里克二世进入该港，这里成为王国的大西洋海军基地，设有类似塞维利亚和巴塞罗那的王家船厂。1466年，恩里克四世把该城赐给桑蒂利亚纳侯爵。1596至1597年的鼠疫使两千五百居民只剩八百人。

1748年，王室下令修筑经雷诺萨的道路，把卡斯蒂利亚的羊毛和面粉运往港口；1754年桑坦德设立教区，圣体修道院的教堂成为主教座堂，1755年费尔南多六世授予它城市称号。1765年起与西属美洲自由贸易，使它的商业向大西洋敞开，1783年成立海陆商事法庭。十九世纪初，桑坦德在半岛北部与美洲各主要港口的往来中居领先地位，1833年成为省会。

english: Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi stands on a hill in the inland country of Irpinia. The Normans fortified its castle in 1076. Nearby, William of Vercelli founded the abbey of Goleto in 1133–34 on land given by Roger of Monticchio. The religious community grew to include separate houses for women and men, with churches built amid the remains of an older Roman site.
simp_chinese: 圣安杰洛代伦巴第坐落在伊尔皮尼亚内陆的一座山丘上。诺曼人于1076年加强了当地城堡。附近的戈莱托修道院由韦尔切利的古列尔莫于1133至1134年在蒙蒂基奥的罗杰捐赠的土地上创建。修院后来设有男女分住的院舍，教堂建在一处更古老的罗马遗址之间。

english: Sant'Arcangelo stands above the Agri valley in Basilicata, among hills of olives and vines. Nearby, on the hill of Orsoleo, a Franciscan convent overlooks the routes between the Agri and Sinni valleys. The complex was rebuilt in 1474 around an older church and entrusted to the Observant Franciscans. Its church and cloister became a place of prayer and study for the surrounding region, joining the hill town to a wider network of religious houses.
simp_chinese: 圣阿尔坎杰洛坐落在巴西利卡塔的阿格里河谷上方，周围丘陵种植橄榄和葡萄。附近奥尔索莱奥山上的方济各会修道院俯瞰阿格里与辛尼河谷之间的道路。建筑群于1474年围绕一座旧教堂重建，并交给严规方济各会士。教堂和回廊成为周边地区祈祷与学习之所，将山城连接到更广泛的宗教机构网络。

english:
Santarém stands on a bluff above the Tagus, the old capital of the Ribatejo. The Romans called it Scallabis, and under Muslim rule, as Shantarin, it became a cultural centre. On 15 March 1147 Afonso Henriques took it by a night attack, when a few men climbed the walls and opened the gates, an exploit told in the chronicle De expugnatione Scalabis. For a time the town of Saint Irene, the martyr who gave it its name, was one of the most important in Portugal.

Medieval kings came often to its royal palace, and many sessions of the Cortes were held here. Ferdinand I loved the town and chose to be buried in the Convent of São Francisco. In the fifteenth century the expedition against Ceuta in 1415 was planned in the palace of Santarém, in the age of discoveries. Pedro de Meneses, Ceuta's first governor, lies in a Gothic tomb in the Church of Graça, and in the same church rests Pedro Álvares Cabral, who reached Brazil in 1500. The court gradually drifted to coastal Lisbon, and the city lost its importance. Earthquakes damaged it in 1531 and in 1755, and in the Napoleonic invasions the French pillaged it.
simp_chinese:
圣塔伦坐落在特茹河上方的一处高崖上，是里巴特茹的旧首府。罗马人称它斯卡拉比斯，穆斯林统治时期它叫尚塔林，是一处文化中心。1147年3月15日，阿方索·恩里克斯夜袭夺城，几个人爬上城墙，打开城门，编年史《斯卡拉比斯攻取记》讲述了这次壮举。这座以殉道者圣伊里亚得名的城市，曾是葡萄牙最重要的城镇之一。

中世纪的国王常到它的王宫，许多次葡萄牙议会（Cortes）在这里召开。费尔南多一世钟爱此城，选择葬在圣方济各修道院。在大发现时代的15世纪，1415年远征休达的计划就是在圣塔伦的王宫里制订的。休达首任总督佩德罗·德·梅内塞斯安葬在恩典教堂的哥特式墓中，1500年抵达巴西的佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔也安息在这座教堂里。宫廷逐渐转向滨海的里斯本，圣塔伦随之失势。1531年和1755年的地震先后破坏了城市，拿破仑入侵时它又遭法军劫掠。

english:
The Santee country lies along the rivers and lowlands of coastal South Carolina. Indigenous communities used its waters for travel and fishing, while nearby fields and forests supplied crops, game and materials. The Santee people belonged to the varied native societies encountered by European colonists in the Carolina region. Their lives were disrupted by disease, warfare and the destructive trade in enslaved indigenous people during the colonial expansion.

In 1701 the English traveller John Lawson encountered Santee and Wateree people along the river. In 1715 the Santee joined other Indigenous peoples in the Yamasee War against Carolina's colonists and traders; after the conflict, Santee and Wateree people withdrew toward Catawba settlements. Meanwhile, English settlement and rice plantations increasingly reshaped the lowcountry, relying on the forced labour and knowledge of enslaved Africans.
simp_chinese:
桑蒂地区沿南卡罗来纳沿海河流与低地展开。原住民社群利用水道交通和捕鱼，附近田地与森林提供作物、猎物及材料。桑蒂人属于欧洲殖民者在卡罗来纳接触的多样本土社会。随着殖民扩张，他们的生活遭到疾病、战争及贩卖原住民为奴的破坏性贸易冲击，人口和土地关系发生深刻变化。

1701年，英格兰旅行者约翰·劳森沿河遇见桑蒂人和沃特里人。1715年，桑蒂人同其他原住民族群一起，在亚马西战争中反抗卡罗来纳殖民者和商人；冲突后，桑蒂人与沃特里人退向卡托巴人的聚落。与此同时，英格兰殖民与稻米种植园日益改变沿海低地，种植园依赖被奴役非洲人的强迫劳动和知识。

english: Santeh lies in the mountain country east of Saqqez, among the ridges of Iranian Kurdistan. Villages occupy sheltered valleys between pastures, and stone houses rise along the slopes. The surrounding country has long been home to Kurdish communities whose flocks grazed the uplands. Streams from these mountains flow northward toward the basin of Lake Urmia.
simp_chinese: 桑特位于萨盖兹以东的山区，坐落在伊朗库尔德斯坦的山脊之间。村庄占据牧场之间较为隐蔽的谷地，石屋沿山坡而建。周围土地长期为库尔德社群的家园，羊群在高地放牧；山间溪流向北流往乌尔米耶湖盆地。

english:
Santiago is the largest of the Cape Verde islands and the first to be settled by the Portuguese. Mountains and valleys rise behind its southern shore, where Ribeira Grande became a meeting place of Atlantic routes. The island's society grew from encounters between Europeans and Africans, many of the latter brought there in bondage, and gave rise to a distinctive Creole culture.

In 1462 António de Noli and settlers from Portugal established Ribeira Grande. Its position helped make the town a port of call for ships traveling between Africa, Europe and the Americas. From the sixteenth century it also became a center of the trade in enslaved Africans. Churches and the carved pillory in the town square testified to the institutions of colonial rule, while the royal fort of São Filipe was built above the town after Francis Drake's raid in 1585.

The wealth of Ribeira Grande drew further attackers. In 1712 the French privateer Jacques Cassard struck the town, which subsequently declined as Praia grew in importance. The colonial capital moved to Praia in 1770, but the older port remained a mark of the island's place in Atlantic navigation and the history of enslavement. Ships calling at Santiago carried people and goods between the West African coast, Brazil and the Caribbean, connecting the island to distant shores.
simp_chinese:
圣地亚哥是佛得角群岛最大的岛屿，也是葡萄牙人最早定居的岛。南岸背后山谷起伏，海边的大里贝拉成为大西洋航线的交汇之地。岛上社会在欧洲人与非洲人的相遇中形成，许多非洲人是被奴役带来的；这种相遇孕育出独特的克里奥尔文化。

1462年，安东尼奥·德诺利与来自葡萄牙的移民建立大里贝拉。凭借地理位置，城镇成为往来非洲、欧洲与美洲的船只停靠之地。十六世纪起，它也成为贩运被奴役非洲人的中心。教堂和广场上雕刻精美的示众柱体现了殖民统治的制度；1585年弗朗西斯·德雷克袭击之后，圣菲利普皇家堡垒建在城镇上方。

大里贝拉的财富引来更多袭击。1712年，法国私掠船长雅克·卡萨尔攻打城镇，此后大里贝拉逐渐衰落，普拉亚则日益重要。1770年，殖民地首府迁往普拉亚，而旧港仍保存着这座岛屿参与大西洋航行与奴役历史的印记。停靠圣地亚哥的船只在西非海岸、巴西与加勒比之间运送人口和货物，使岛屿与遥远海岸相连。

english: Santiago is a volcanic island in the Galápagos, with a rugged coast and a scarce supply of fresh water. A small seep near Buccaneer Cove was recorded by sailors including William Dampier and Ambrose Cowley in 1684, and later by the privateer Woodes Rogers. Visiting ships also took giant tortoises as provisions. In 1835 Charles Darwin visited the island and noted the spring used by tortoise hunters to obtain their daily water.
simp_chinese: 圣地亚哥是加拉帕戈斯群岛的一座火山岛，海岸崎岖，淡水稀少。1684年，威廉·丹皮尔和安布罗斯·考利等水手记下了海盗湾附近的一处小泉眼；后来私掠船长伍兹·罗杰斯也提到它。来访船只还捕取巨型陆龟作为补给。1835年，查尔斯·达尔文到访此岛，记下了猎龟人获取日常饮水的泉水。

english: Santianna Point forms the low western end of Coats Island in northern Hudson Bay. Inland from the shore lies a plain dotted with ponds and raised beaches, while shallow water extends out from the point. Across the entrance to Fisher Strait stands Cape Low on Southampton Island. Walrus use the ice and islands between the two shores, and Inuit travel to Coats Island to hunt caribou. The strait opens southwest towards the wider bay.
simp_chinese: 圣蒂安娜角是哈得孙湾北部科茨岛低平的西端。岸后平原上散布着池塘和抬升的海滩，岬角外则是延伸向海的浅水。隔着菲舍尔海峡入口，南安普顿岛上的洛角与之相望。海象活动于两岸之间的海冰与岛屿，因纽特人也前往科茨岛猎取北美驯鹿。海峡向西南通往开阔的海湾。

english: Cape Santiago, known as Sandiaojiao, marks the easternmost point of Taiwan. Here the northern end of the Xueshan range reaches the sea, forming a rocky headland on the island’s northeastern coast. The cape belongs to a shore of alternating bays and promontories, shaped as the sea and weather wore away rocks of differing hardness.
simp_chinese: 三貂角是台湾岛最东端的岬角。雪山山脉北端在此伸入海中，在岛屿东北岸形成岩石岬角。这一带海岸湾岬相间，海水和风化侵蚀不同硬度的岩层，塑造出曲折的岸线。

english: Santo Antão is the northwesternmost island of Cape Verde, a mountainous land separated from São Vicente by a narrow channel. Deep valleys cut through its volcanic slopes, and the town of Ribeira Grande grew in one of them. Diogo Afonso reached the island in 1461 or 1462, and settlement began in the first half of the sixteenth century. Ribeira Grande became the principal settlement and, in 1732, the seat of the island's municipality.
simp_chinese: 圣安唐是佛得角群岛最西北的岛屿，山峦耸立，一条狭窄海峡将它与圣维森特岛隔开。深谷切入火山山坡，里贝拉格兰德城便在其中一条谷地发展起来。迪奥戈·阿丰索于1461或1462年抵达此岛，十六世纪上半叶开始有人定居。里贝拉格兰德成为主要聚落，并在1732年成为全岛的行政中心。

english: The Santo Antônio River runs through the wooded uplands of southwestern Paraná toward the Iguaçu. Together with the Chopim and other streams, it drains a country of forested hills and open fields. These lands formed part of the extensive territory of the Kaingang before colonial expeditions and settlers pushed into the southern Brazilian plateau.
simp_chinese: 圣安东尼奥河流经巴拉那西南部森林覆盖的高地，流向伊瓜苏河。它与绍平河等水道共同为林木覆盖的丘陵与开阔原野排水。在殖民远征队和定居者进入巴西南部高原之前，这些土地是凯因甘人广大领地的一部分。

english: Santo Antônio do Monte grew around a chapel on a hill in western Minas Gerais. In 1758 Lopo Barroso Pereira received a land grant beside the Itaubira stream, close to the chapel and land he had already occupied. Families settled on farms in the surrounding country, and the chapel became the centre of their community. It received a baptismal font in 1802.
simp_chinese: 圣安东尼奥杜蒙特围绕米纳斯吉拉斯西部山丘上的一座小教堂发展。1758年，洛普·巴罗苏·佩雷拉在伊陶比拉溪旁获得土地，靠近教堂和他此前已占据的土地。众多家庭在周围农场定居，小教堂成为社区中心，并于1802年获准设置洗礼池。

english:
Santok stands where the Noteć joins the Warta, a crossing long guarded by a fortified settlement. The chronicler Gallus Anonymus called it a key to the Polish realm on the Pomeranian frontier. In the thirteenth century the fortress became a focus of rivalry between Greater Poland and the margraves of Brandenburg; after several changes of hands it passed to Brandenburg in 1296.

King Casimir III recovered Santok temporarily in 1365, but its old fortress later lost much of its importance to nearby Landsberg. In 1402 the Neumark was sold to the Teutonic Order, and Hussite troops devastated Santok in 1433. A great flood changed the course of the Warta in 1751, leaving the old stronghold separated from the river's new channel; Russian troops plundered the settlement in 1758.
simp_chinese:
桑托克位于诺泰奇河汇入瓦尔塔河之处，一座设防聚落长期守卫着这一交汇点。编年史家加卢斯·阿诺尼穆斯称它为波兰王国在波美拉尼亚边境的钥匙。十三世纪，这座堡垒成为大波兰与勃兰登堡藩侯争夺的焦点；几经易手后，它于1296年归属勃兰登堡。

1365年，卡齐米日三世国王暂时收复桑托克，但堡垒后来被附近兰茨贝格的兴起所取代。1402年，诺伊马克被售予条顿骑士团；1433年，胡斯派军队破坏了桑托克。1751年的大洪水改变瓦尔塔河道，使旧堡垒与新河道分离；1758年俄罗斯军队又劫掠了聚落。

english: Santokhe, known in Chinese as Santanghu, lies in the dry basin north of Barkol. Its name recalls three patches of water and grass among the hills. The oasis offered a stopping place on routes across the Gobi, where camel caravans could rest before continuing towards Mongolia. Across the wider Barkol country, old beacon towers mark the network of communication routes through the frontier.
simp_chinese: 三都克即三塘湖，位于巴里坤以北干旱盆地。地名使人想起丘陵间三处水草地。绿洲为穿越戈壁的道路提供歇脚处，骆驼商队在此休整后继续向蒙古前行。巴里坤广大地区仍有古代烽燧，标示着穿越边地的通信网络。

english:
Beneath Mount Santubong, near the mouth of the Sarawak River, lay one of western Borneo's important early trading centers. The river gave access to a forested hinterland rich in camphor, resin and rattan, while ships arriving from the South China Sea brought goods from farther afield. Chinese ceramics, glass beads and religious images found in the area testify to these connections.

Santubong also had a substantial iron-working industry. Slag found at sites such as Sungai Jaong and Bongkisam lies alongside imported ceramics, many dating from the Song and early Yuan periods. The settlement's most active centuries appear to have been the twelfth and thirteenth, before the close of the medieval era. Its remains reveal a coast where local production and overseas exchange met long before later colonial ports emerged.
simp_chinese:
桑都望山脚下、砂拉越河口附近，曾有婆罗洲西部重要的早期贸易中心。河流通向盛产樟脑、树脂和藤条的森林腹地，来自南中国海的船只则带来更远地区的货物。当地发现的中国陶瓷、玻璃珠和宗教造像见证了这些联系。

桑都望还有规模可观的铁器生产。双溪饶昂和邦基萨姆等遗址的炉渣与进口陶瓷一同出土，许多陶瓷可追溯至宋和元初时期。聚落最活跃的时期似乎是十二至十三世纪，早于中世纪结束。这些遗存展现了地方生产与海外交换交汇的海岸，远早于后来殖民港口的兴起。

english: Sanyao lies in the mountainous Shangzhou region of southeastern Shaanxi, where valleys and passes connect different parts of central China and level ground is scarce. Cultivation clings to narrow valley floors and terraces, while the uplands supply timber and grazing. Roads through the passes carried traffic between the Guanzhong plain and the Han basin, and settlements along them depended on this movement.
simp_chinese: 三要位于陕西东南的商州山地，河谷与山口连接中国中部不同地区，平坦土地稀少。耕作集中在狭窄的河谷与梯田上，高地则提供木材和牧场。穿越山口的道路把关中平原与汉水流域连接起来，沿途聚落依赖这种往来。

english: In the dry country near Habaswein, the waters of the Ewaso Ng'iro spread into the Lorian Swamp. The river rises on Mount Kenya and the Aberdares, but its floodwaters reach far into the northeastern lowlands. Grasses and sedges grow in different parts of the wetland according to the depth and duration of flooding. Farther southeast, Sanye is a name shared by several hunting peoples, including the Dahalo of the lower Tana.
simp_chinese: 哈巴斯韦因附近地势干旱，埃瓦索恩吉罗河的水却在这里漫成洛里安沼泽。河流发源于肯尼亚山和阿伯代尔山脉，洪水远达东北低地。湿地各处的积水深浅和持续时间不同，因而生长着不同的草与莎草。更东南方的塔纳河下游，达哈洛人等狩猎社群也被称作桑耶。

english: Sanyuan lies in central Shaanxi, north of the Wei River plain and near the lower Jing River. The county was established under Northern Wei in 446; an early geographical work explains its name by reference to three nearby tablelands. During the Ming and Qing periods, merchants from Sanyuan became prominent among Shaanxi's trading networks. They carried grain, cloth and tea toward the northwestern frontier and obtained salt permits, then traded in salt from the Huai region and Sichuan. Their activities connected a farming county on the Guanzhong plain with markets and supply routes far beyond it.
simp_chinese: 三原位于陕西中部、渭河平原北缘和泾河下游附近。北魏太平真君七年（446年）置县；《元和郡县志》以附近三处原地解释其名称。明清时期，三原商人是陕西商帮的重要力量，他们把粮食、布匹和茶叶运往西北边地，换取盐引，再到两淮和四川经营盐业。商人的路线将关中平原的农业县城与远方市场和边地供应联系起来。

english: Sanyyakhtakh stands on the left bank of the Lena and takes its name from a local stream. The great river passes through wooded country here on its way toward central Yakutia. In the eighteenth century a postal station was established at Sanyyakhtakh on the route linking Vitim and Yakutsk. Horses and drivers relayed travellers and messages between stations along the river, spanning the vast distances of the Siberian interior.
simp_chinese: 桑尼亚赫塔赫位于勒拿河左岸，以当地溪流得名。大河在此流经林地，继续向雅库特中部流去。十八世纪，维季姆至雅库茨克驿路在桑尼亚赫塔赫设站。沿河各站的马匹和驿夫接力运送旅客与消息，跨越西伯利亚内陆的漫长距离。

english: Sanzana lies in the wooded savanna of southern Mali, in the country of farming villages between the upper Niger basin and the Mouhoun. The wider region has long been home to Senufo-speaking communities as well as Mande-speaking neighbours. Seasonal rains sustain fields of grain, while trees and pasture surround the settlements. Routes through this country link the villages of the southern savanna with the trading centres of the western Volta basin.
simp_chinese: 桑扎纳位于马里南部林地草原，处在尼日尔河上游流域与穆翁河之间的农业村落地区。广大地区长期是塞努福语社群及其曼德语邻居的家园。季节性降雨滋养谷物田地，树木和牧场环绕聚落。穿越这片土地的道路将南部草原村落与西伏尔塔河流域的贸易中心相连。

english: The country later known as São Carlos lies on the inland plateau of São Paulo, among the headwaters of rivers flowing toward the Tietê. A trail toward the gold mines of Goiás and Cuiabá crossed the region in the late eighteenth century. Land grants followed, including the Pinhal estate, whose boundaries were formally measured in 1831. Cattle and sugar cultivation developed on these lands.
simp_chinese: 后来称为圣卡洛斯的地区位于圣保罗内陆高原，附近河流发源后流向提埃特河。十八世纪末，一条通往戈亚斯与库亚巴金矿的小路穿过这里。随后出现土地授予，其中皮尼亚尔庄园于1831年正式划定边界；养牛和甘蔗种植在这些土地上发展起来。

english: São Fidélis lies beside the Paraíba do Sul in the wooded interior of Rio de Janeiro. Coroado and Puri peoples inhabited this region before colonial settlements expanded along the river. In 1781 Capuchin friars Vitório de Cambiasca and Ângelo Maria de Luca arrived to establish a mission among Indigenous communities. The settlement that grew around their work became São Fidélis.
simp_chinese: 圣菲德利斯位于里约热内卢森林覆盖的内陆，坐落在南帕拉伊巴河畔。殖民聚落沿河扩展之前，科罗阿多人和普里人居住于此。1781年，嘉布遣会修士维托里奥·迪坎比亚斯卡和安杰洛·玛丽亚·迪卢卡抵达，在原住民社区中建立传教聚落。围绕他们活动形成的聚落后来成为圣菲德利斯。

english: The São Francisco reaches the Atlantic between Alagoas and Sergipe, after a long course through the Brazilian interior. Its estuary meets a coastal plain of dunes, wetlands, mangroves and sandy ridges. The river carries fresh water and sediment toward the sea, where shoals mark the meeting of river and ocean. Known to the Portuguese as the São Francisco from the early sixteenth century, it became a route into the interior of northeastern Brazil.
simp_chinese: 圣弗朗西斯科河穿过巴西内陆，最终在阿拉戈斯与塞尔希培之间注入大西洋。河口濒临由沙丘、湿地、红树林和沙脊组成的海岸平原。河水将淡水与泥沙带向大海，在河海交会处形成浅滩。葡萄牙人自十六世纪初称其为圣弗朗西斯科河，后来沿河进入巴西东北部内陆。

english:
São João del-Rei grew in the basin of the Rio das Mortes, among the mountains of Minas Gerais. Gold-bearing gravels attracted settlers from São Paulo, and a mining camp developed into a town whose churches and streets reflect the wealth and ambitions of the colonial gold districts. Its place on the roads through southern Minas made it a centre of trade as well as mining.

The early settlement stood amid the conflicts of the War of the Emboabas, when rivals fought over the new goldfields. In 1713 it became a town named for King João V and subsequently expanded as a centre of the Rio das Mortes district. Churches and religious brotherhoods played a prominent part in its public life. The town was also drawn into the disturbances of 1720, when opposition to royal taxes and foundries spread across the mining region. Its commercial connections helped sustain it as the great gold rush passed.
simp_chinese:
圣若昂德尔雷兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯群山中的莫尔蒂斯河流域。含金砂砾吸引圣保罗移民前来，采矿营地逐渐发展为城镇；教堂与街道反映出殖民金矿地区的财富和雄心。它位于穿过米纳斯南部的道路上，也是商业与采矿中心。

早期聚落经历了恩博阿巴斯战争，争夺新金矿的对手在这一带交战。1713年，它以国王若昂五世之名升格为镇，随后发展为莫尔蒂斯河辖区的中心。教堂与宗教兄弟会在公共生活中占有重要地位。1720年，反对王室税收和熔金所的动乱席卷矿区，镇上也受到影响。淘金热过去后，商业联系帮助这座城镇维持活力。

english: The high country around São Joaquim forms part of the southern Brazilian plateau, where cool weather, grasslands and araucaria forest distinguish the landscape from the coastal lowlands. The Xokleng and Kaingang inhabited these uplands before colonial settlement expanded along cattle routes. Streams descend from the heights toward the rivers that cross the plateau and the valleys leading to the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 圣若阿金周围的高地属于巴西南部高原，凉爽气候、草原和南洋杉森林使其景观有别于沿海低地。殖民定居沿牛群运输道路扩张之前，肖克伦人和凯因甘人居住在这些高地。溪流从山上流下，流向穿过高原的河流及通往大西洋的河谷。

english: Long and narrow, São Jorge lies in the central group of the Azores, separated by sea from its island neighbors. Its high coast is broken by small low-lying coastal plains known as fajãs. Settlements existed on the western and southern shores by about 1470, when the Fleming Willem van der Haegen established himself at Topo. Velas became a town before the end of the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 狭长的圣若热岛位于亚速尔群岛中部，与邻岛隔海相望。高峻的海岸间分布着称为法让的小片滨海平地。约1470年，岛的西岸和南岸已有聚落，佛兰德人威廉·范德哈亨在托普定居。十五世纪末以前，韦拉什获授市镇地位。

english: The wooded plateau south of Curitiba was known for its stands of araucaria, the pines that gave São José dos Pinhais its name. Gold in the rivers drew prospectors into the region during the seventeenth century, and a settlement called Arraial Grande emerged along the Arraial River. Around 1690 a chapel dedicated to Bom Jesus dos Perdões was established on a nearby estate.
simp_chinese: 库里提巴以南的森林高原以南洋杉林闻名，圣若泽杜斯皮尼亚伊斯的名称也与这些树木有关。十七世纪，河流中的黄金吸引探矿者进入该地区，阿拉亚尔河畔出现了阿拉亚尔格兰德聚落。约1690年，附近庄园建立了一座供奉宽恕耶稣的小教堂。

english: The Rio Preto flows through the wooded interior of São Paulo, a landscape of streams and rolling uplands west of the coast. Indigenous communities, including Kaingang and Guarani peoples, inhabited the wider region before the settlement that later took the name São José do Rio Preto. The river belongs to a network of waterways flowing toward the Paraná basin.
simp_chinese: 普雷图河流经圣保罗内陆的森林地区，海岸以西的溪流与起伏高地交错。后来称为圣若泽杜里奥普雷图的聚落出现之前，包括凯因甘人和瓜拉尼人在内的原住民社区已生活在更广阔的地区。河流属于流向巴拉那流域的水道网络。

english: São Leopoldo stands in the valley of the Sinos River, north of the Guaíba waters in southern Brazil. A government hemp plantation, the Real Feitoria do Linho Cânhamo, operated there from 1788 before the site was chosen for a new colony. In 1824 the first group of German immigrants arrived and established São Leopoldo. The river connected their settlement with Porto Alegre and the wider lagoon system.
simp_chinese: 圣莱奥波尔多位于巴西南部锡诺斯河谷，瓜伊巴水域以北。1788年起，政府在此经营皇家大麻种植场，后来选定该地点建立新殖民地。1824年，首批德国移民抵达并建立圣莱奥波尔多。河流将他们的聚落与阿雷格里港及更广阔的潟湖水系相连。

english: São Luís do Paraitinga stands beside the Paraitinga River among the forested hills of the Serra do Mar. Drovers travelling from Taubaté toward the port of Paraty stopped on the riverbank before a settlement was formally laid out in 1769. The place took its name from the river and the governor who ordered its foundation. Mining, sugar mills and dairy farming later supported the community.
simp_chinese: 圣路易斯杜帕赖廷加坐落在海岸山脉森林丘陵中的帕赖廷加河畔。1769年聚落正式规划之前，从陶巴特前往帕拉蒂港的赶牲口者已常在河边停留。地名取自河流和下令建立聚落的总督。此后，采矿、糖坊和乳业为社区提供生计。

english: São Marcos Bay is a broad estuary on the Maranhão coast, west of the island on which São Luís stands. The Mearim and its tributaries bring fresh water into the bay, while powerful tides move through its channels and around low islands. Its wide entrance opens onto the Atlantic; farther inland the waters narrow toward the rivers, creating a route between the coast and the Maranhão interior.
simp_chinese: 圣马科斯湾是马拉尼昂海岸的一处宽阔河口，位于圣路易斯所在岛屿以西。梅阿林河及其支流将淡水带入海湾，强劲潮汐则穿过水道、绕行低矮岛屿。宽阔湾口向大西洋敞开，内陆方向的水域逐渐收窄并通向河流，构成海岸与马拉尼昂腹地之间的通道。

english: São Miguel, the largest of the Azores, lies in the eastern group of the archipelago. Its volcanic shores enclose a landscape of hills and fertile land. Portuguese settlers arrived in the 1440s under Gonçalo Velho Cabral. Vila Franca do Campo became the early center of the island, but a devastating earthquake struck it in 1522. Ponta Delgada on the southern coast grew into an important port and center of commerce.
simp_chinese: 圣米格尔岛是亚速尔群岛最大的岛屿，位于群岛东部。火山海岸环绕着起伏的山地和肥沃土地。十五世纪四十年代，葡萄牙移民在贡萨洛·韦略·卡布拉尔率领下到来。自由镇成为岛上早期中心，却在1522年遭到地震重创；南岸的蓬塔德尔加达则发展为重要的港口和商业中心。

english: São Nicolau is a mountainous island in the northern group of Cape Verde, between Santa Luzia and Sal. Diogo Afonso reached it in 1461 or 1462, but settlement began in the seventeenth century. Pirate attacks led the inhabitants to abandon the coastal settlement of Porto de Lapa in 1653 and establish Ribeira Brava inland. In 1786 the latter became the seat of the Roman Catholic diocese of Santiago de Cabo Verde, bringing an important ecclesiastical office to the island.
simp_chinese: 圣尼古拉岛是佛得角北部群岛中的山地岛屿，位于圣卢西亚岛与萨尔岛之间。迪奥戈·阿丰索于1461或1462年抵达，直到十七世纪才开始有人定居。海盗袭击迫使居民在1653年放弃海岸聚落拉帕港，转而在内陆建立里贝拉布拉瓦。1786年，佛得角圣地亚哥天主教教区的主教座迁至此处，使岛上拥有了一处重要的教会驻地。

english: São Roque lies in the wooded hills west of São Paulo. The settlement developed around a chapel and estate associated with Pedro Vaz de Barros, known as Vaz-Guaçu, who received land in this interior country. Its location placed it among the farms and routes that spread outward from the plateau settlements during the seventeenth century, as colonial families sought land beyond São Paulo.
simp_chinese: 圣罗克位于圣保罗以西林木覆盖的丘陵中。聚落围绕一座小教堂和佩德罗·瓦斯·迪巴罗斯的庄园发展；他又称瓦斯瓜苏，曾在这片内陆地区获得土地。十七世纪，殖民家庭在圣保罗以外寻找土地，农庄与道路从高原聚落向外扩展，圣罗克便位于这一网络之中。

english: São Sebastião lies on the northern coast of São Paulo, facing the island that shares its name across a sheltered channel. Forested mountains rise close behind the narrow coastal plain. The Portuguese settlement became a town in the seventeenth century, serving a region whose economy included sugar production and whale oil.
